source_clock: synthetic seconds from t=0; ns clocks saved without physical transport delay
motion: body omega(t) and alpha(t) scaled from the saved three-frequency profile at the same time; quaternion path reintegrated from unchanged initial pose
rotation: Rz(yaw) Ry(pitch) Rx(roll), body-to-world, Hamilton quaternion xyzw
kinematics: omega_new=scale*omega_old and alpha_new=scale*alpha_old exactly in body coordinates; Euler rates/accelerations derived from the new pose and body kinematics
inertia_scope: known fixed physical tensor shared by generator and both comparison methods; no parameter fit
control: body-CoG torque tau=J alpha+omega cross(J omega), generated once from prescribed motion; saved on 1kHz grid and supplied as known input to both methods
torque_interpolation: reconstruction uses saved known torque with piecewise-linear interpolation; finite input interpolation error
gyro_observation: body omega + fixed bias + independent isotropic Gaussian sensor noise
initial_pose: known prescribed pose once at t=0, shared by all cases
gyro_source_index: original 200Hz sequence index, never renumbered after sparse selection
rpy_path: obtained from integrated quaternion; not original Euler angles divided by the scale factor

quaternion_integration.normalization: remove finite quaternion norm drift only; no state covariance adjustment

scaling_scope: physical motion only; sensor noise, bias, native clocks, inertia, seed and assumed reconstruction sigma unchanged
